about: Who made this build. A copy you build and share must not look like the official Cycles for Houdini: put your own build_name and publisher here before you share an installer. An empty build_id is filled in on first use with an id of your own; keep it afterwards, so that your new installers update your earlier ones. With dlss set to on (the default) an empty dlss_project_id is filled in on first use with a DLSS project id of your own; off builds without DLSS. Changes to this file do not count as local source changes. See docs/dev/community-builds.md. The official release route (scripts/build-release.ps1) does not read this file.
